headline: HuyenBao v11.52 — GitHub auto-deploy webhook
summary: AUTO-DEPLOY. New /api/deploy webhook endpoint receives GitHub push events, verifies the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC with a shared secret, filters to push events on refs/heads/main, then fires scripts/deploy.sh in the background (detached, fire-and-forget so the response returns before systemctl restart kills the process). The deploy script does git fetch + reset --hard origin/main → npm ci → npm run build → sudo systemctl restart huyenbao, logging every step to /var/log/huyenbao-deploy.log. Full setup walk-through in DEPLOY.md (sudoers entry, env vars on the systemd unit, GitHub webhook config, log rotation).
features: NEW: /api/deploy route — GitHub webhook receiver with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification (timingSafeEqual, fail-closed if secret unset)
NEW: filters to push events on refs/heads/main only — other events (PR, issues, branch pushes) logged + ignored
NEW: GET /api/deploy — quick health check showing whether auto-deploy is configured (no secret leak)
NEW: scripts/deploy.sh — git fetch + reset --hard origin/main → npm ci → npm run build → sudo systemctl restart huyenbao
NEW: deploy script is detached + unref'd so it survives the systemctl restart that kills the webhook's parent process
NEW: /var/log/huyenbao-deploy.log — every deploy logged with timestamp + commit + pusher + repo
NEW: DEPLOY.md — full setup walk-through (sudoers entry, env vars, GitHub webhook config, log rotation, manual fallback)
SECURITY: fail-closed if DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var is unset (503 deploy-not-configured)
SECURITY: signature compared with timingSafeEqual — no timing side-channel on the secret
SECURITY: sudoers entry grants ONLY `systemctl restart huyenbao` — service user gains no other root privileges
SECURITY: git reset --hard origin/main discards any local VPS edits — never edit files on the server directly
Static build unchanged: route.ts excluded from GitHub Pages build (pageExtensions: ['tsx'])
